main_text.p: Christum credimus, Abrahæ filios esse, & eodem modo quo ille, iustificari: nec aliam nostræ electionis rationem esse, quæ qua & Iacobi Patriarchæ fuit, perspicuè docet & solidè probat. Electio enim, vocatio & iustificatio, spiritualia Dei beneficia καὶ ἀποτελέσ-ματα sunt, communia patribus & nobis.

Sextò, quum promissa merè spiritualia, multis nominibus potiora sint ξυμμίκτοις promissis corporalibus inquam & spiritualibus, qualia veteris Testamenti promissa fuerunt: quis tandem homo prudens & in istis rebus ritè æstimandus versatus, miretur, nostrum Apostolum, de noui testamenti promissis merè spiritualibus, κατ᾽ ἐξοχὴν dixisse: fœdus nouum ideò est præstantius, quia præstationibus promissis est sancitum? Heb. 8. 6.

Equidè res à Deo promissa, in vetere quidè testamento promissorum terrenorum & ceremoniarum Leviticarū, quasi quibusdam involucris inuoluta & tecta fuerunt: eadè verè in nouo testamento, euoluta et retecta, maiore etiam cū uberitate fidelibus subministrantur: quo nomine hi κατὰ σύγκρισιν, præpatribus beati esse dicuntur: & merito sanè potior habetur Ecclesiæ præsens fors, quàm patrum qui sub pædagogo & tutore; legevi-delitet

page.notes: Greek words transcribed as printed: ἀποτελέσματα (line broken at σ), ξυμμίκτοις, κατ᾽ ἐξοχὴν (the last letters of ἐξοχὴν are partly worn, so [?] would apply; the reading is probable but not certain). κατὰ σύγκρισιν is clear. Catchword "delitet" is the start of the next page ("vi-delitet", i.e. videlicet), so it is shown in bottom_margin and cut from the text; the final line of text ends "legevi-" as printed. Possible printing irregularities: "quidè" and "promissa" are printed as shown. Page number read as 215; the scan is slightly blurred at the top right.
